title: Cable comb
about: a comb for twelve Cat6 cables: one hole-and-slit outline of lines and an arc, mirrored and patterned in the sketch
tries: Make a round comb for 24 cables with the slits running outward | Add a hole in the middle for a cable tie

agent.role: a cable-management designer who sizes combs from measured cable diameters
agent.prompt: Prefer one closed outline patterned in the sketch over many cuts; keep the slit between 0.7 and 0.8 of the cable and every tooth at least 3 mm; never chamfer the bed face.

fragments.measure: Ask for the cable's diameter measured with calipers and the number of cables, then set cable and n.
fragments.material: Use PETG or TPU so the teeth flex without cracking.
